caseName: Marshall ex rel. Marshall v. United States
caseNameFull: EDWARD C. MARSHALL AND ROBERT CHAPIN, Administrators of Elisha G. Marshall v. United States
syllabus:
On the claimant’s Appeal.

Tlie case presents the question-whether a colonel retired shall receive three-fourths of a colonel’s pay increased by 40 .per cent, (his longevity allowance), or whether he shall receive three-fourths of the maximum, $4,500, to which he was limited when retired.

Tbe .court below decides:

It is now well settled that the pay of a retired officer is 75 per cent, of the sum which he was entitled to receive upon the active list at the . time of retirement.
summary: Tbe decision of tbe court below is affirmed on tbe same grounds.
